name: Itchgrass
hint: A tall, stiff grass whose leaf sheaths carry glassy hairs that prick and itch the skin, topped by a thin, round, jointed spike.

name: Cogon
local: Kogon, kugon, gogon, ilib, panaw, parang
hint: Upright grass with stiff leaves that have a pale midrib and rough edges, tough white runners underground, and fluffy silvery white flower spikes.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Kogon
Abad and San Juan 1981, Replacing cogon under coconut with legume cover crops (AGRIS)
DA High Value Crops Development Program, Rubber Production Guide

name: Wild sugarcane
hint: Very tall clumps like a thin wild sugarcane, with sharp edged leaves, fluffy white plumes and deep spreading runners.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Talahib

name: Johnson grass
hint: Tall grass like a wild sorghum, with wide leaves that have a white midrib, a loose purplish seed head and thick white runners underground.

sources.label: Caasi Lit and Fernandez 2006, Alternate hosts of Asian corn borer in major Philippine corn areas (AGRIS)

name: Para grass
hint: Coarse creeping grass that roots at its hairy joints and forms thick mats in wet ground, with a seed head of short side branches.

sources.label: Caasi Lit and Fernandez 2006, Alternate hosts of Asian corn borer in major Philippine corn areas (AGRIS)

name: Swollen fingergrass
hint: Tufted grass with flattened stems and a top of 6 to 15 purplish, feathery fingers spread like an open hand.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Korokorosan

name: Whitehead spikesedge
hint: Low sedge with a three sided stem ending in one round, white flower head with three leafy bracts under it.

sources.label: Philippine Traditional Knowledge Digital Library on Health: Busikad
Philippine Traditional Knowledge Digital Library on Health: Uli uli, anuang, malabutones

name: Siam weed
hint: Rambling shrub up to 2 m with arrow shaped, three veined leaves in pairs that smell strong when crushed, and pale mauve to white flower tufts.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Hagonoy

name: Mile a minute vine
hint: Fast twining vine with heart shaped leaves in pairs and small clusters of white flowers that blanket shrubs and young trees; Mikania micrantha looks almost the same.

sources.label: PROSEA, Mikania cordata and Mikania micrantha

name: Billygoat weed
hint: Soft, hairy herb with paired, egg shaped, toothed leaves, a goat like smell when crushed, and small fluffy blue to white flower heads.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Bulak manok
Abit, Dimas and Ramirez 2022, Weed survey of small scale vegetable farms in Ormoc City, Philippines (AGRIS)

name: Spanish needle
local: Dadayem, puriket, pisau pisau, tubak tubak
hint: Upright herb with leaves split into 3 to 5 toothed parts, small white and yellow flower heads, and black needle seeds that stick to clothes.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Dadayem
UP Baguio Herbarium specimen of Bidens pilosa, La Trinidad, Benguet

name: Gallant soldier
hint: Soft, branching herb with paired, toothed, egg shaped leaves and tiny flower heads of 5 short white rays around a yellow center.

sources.label: Abit, Dimas and Ramirez 2022, Weed survey of small scale vegetable farms in Ormoc City, Philippines (AGRIS)

name: Tropical chickweed
hint: Low creeping herb with thin stems, small round leaves in pairs and tiny white flowers; its sticky seeds cling to clothes.

sources.label: Abit, Dimas and Ramirez 2022, Weed survey of small scale vegetable farms in Ormoc City, Philippines (AGRIS)

name: Nodeweed
hint: Upright herb with paired, three veined, toothed leaves and small yellow flower heads tucked right at the leaf joints.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Fantankuen

name: Asthma weed
hint: Low, hairy herb with reddish stems that bleed white milky sap and round clusters of tiny greenish flowers at the leaf joints.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Gatas gatas

name: Coat buttons
hint: Creeping, hairy herb with coarsely toothed paired leaves and a single flower head on a long stalk, with 5 short cream rays around a yellow center.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Coat buttons

name: Common wireweed
hint: Stiff, woody based shrublet with narrow toothed leaves and small yellow flowers at the leaf joints; the tough stems are hard to pull.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Escobilla

name: Caesar weed
hint: Woody shrub with rough, shallowly lobed leaves, small pink flowers, and burr fruits with hooked spines that stick to clothes.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Dalupang

name: Lantana
hint: Prickly stemmed shrub with rough, strong smelling leaves and flat clusters of small yellow, orange and pink flowers that turn into black berries.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Kantutay

name: Bush mint
hint: Strong smelling, hairy herb up to 2 m with square stems, toothed paired leaves and small blue purple flowers.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Suob kabayo

name: Creeping woodsorrel
hint: Low creeping herb with clover like leaves of three heart shaped leaflets, a sour taste and small yellow five petaled flowers.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Taingang daga

name: Little ironweed
hint: Upright herb with alternate egg shaped leaves and many tiny purple, thistle like flower heads that turn into fluffy seeds.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Agas moro

name: Lilac tasselflower
local: Tagulinaw, cetim, kipot kipot, lamlampaka, libun
hint: Small herb with purplish backed leaves that clasp the stem and slender pink to purple tassel like flower heads.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Tagulinaw

name: Blue snakeweed
hint: Woody based herb with toothed leaves and long, thin, whip like spikes that open a few small blue flowers at a time.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Kandikandilaan

name: Elephant foot
hint: Flat rosette of rough, hairy, tongue shaped leaves pressed to the ground, with stiff forked stems carrying small purple flower heads.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Dila dila

name: Stinking passion flower
local: Prutas baguio, marya marya, pasyonaryang mabaho, kurombot, lurunggut
hint: Climbing vine with coiled tendrils, three lobed hairy leaves that smell bad, white and purple fringed flowers, and small fruits wrapped in a lacy husk.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Prutas baguio

name: Black nightshade
hint: Soft upright herb with egg shaped leaves, small white star flowers with yellow centers and clusters of shiny black berries; the unripe berries are poisonous.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Lubi lubi

name: Spreading hogweed
hint: Spreading herb with thick reddish stems, paired round leaves pale underneath, tiny pink flowers on long thin stalks and sticky fruits.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Paanbalibis

name: Sickle senna
hint: Bushy, bad smelling herb with leaves of 3 pairs of rounded leaflets, bright yellow flowers in pairs and long, thin, curved pods.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Katandang aso

name: Silver cockscomb
hint: Upright herb with narrow leaves and pointed, silvery white to pink flower spikes shaped like candle flames.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Kindayohan

name: Forked fern
hint: Ground fern that forms thick, springy tangles, with stiff fronds that fork again and again and a small bud in each fork.

sources.label: Stuartxchange, Philippine Medicinal Plants: Kilob

name: Chinese violet
hint: Low, sprawling herb with soft, egg shaped leaves in pairs and white or pale purple bell shaped flowers along one side of the stalk; it grows even in shade.

sources.label: PROTA, Asystasia gangetica
